'''Agomar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Agomar system/Legends|Agomar system]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. During the [[Battle of Agomar]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] pitted its [[Droid Army]] against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], with the world eventually falling back onto Republic control.<ref name="TEA" /> [[Whaladon/Legends|Whaladons]] were found on the planet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>
